profile_text.body:
Consensus operates an AI-powered academic search engine at consensus.app, focused on peer-reviewed scientific literature. The company describes its product as a "research OS" for finding, organizing, and analyzing science, and claims it enables users to work 10x faster than conventional methods.

The platform, also called Consensus, is categorized as a search and research tool. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations appear in the available data.
